rationale_summary: The document primarily frames AI governance around ensuring safe and secure use of AI in business contexts, reducing social risks such as misinformation, IP infringement, and other harms that arise from AI deployment. The goal-based, risk-based approach is centered on protecting society from AI risks while enabling innovation, with safety and security language dominant throughout.

evidence_spans.quote: these Guidelines present a unified direction for AI governance in Japan so that safe and secure use of AI will be promoted

with generative AI there are new social risks that previous AI did not pose, such as infringement of intellectual property rights and the generation and dissemination of misinformation and disinformation

it is important to understand in advance the magnitude of risks that can arise from the mode of use in a given field and to align the degree of countermeasures with the magnitude of risk under a risk-based approach
social friction caused by those risks can itself inhibit the use of AI
